projects.title: Retail AI Platform
projects.description: A product-minded case study for a retail operations platform that connected internal requests, reporting, and AI-assisted decision support in one workflow.
projects.problem: Retail teams need a single place to track requests, surface insights, and respond faster without switching between disconnected tools.
projects.objectives: Design a centralized workspace that could simplify request handling, surface operational insights, and support faster decisions without overwhelming the end user.
projects.businessNeed: The platform needed to help operators and leaders move from observation to action quickly while keeping the experience clear and maintainable for ongoing use.

features.title: Operations dashboard
features.description: A centralized view for tracking requests, status updates, and key retail metrics.

features: Role-aware workflows for admins, analysts, and operators.

features.title: AI-assisted insights
features.description: A lightweight layer for summarizing trends and surfacing recommendations without adding unnecessary complexity.

challenges.challenge: Keeping the interface simple while still supporting multiple retail workflows.
challenges.solution: A modular layout with clearly scoped sections allowed the experience to stay readable while supporting different roles.

projects.lessonsLearned: A strong product narrative depends on framing the workflow clearly, connecting the experience to measurable value, and keeping the interface calm under real operational pressure.
futureImprovements: Add deeper analytics, production telemetry, and feedback loops.
Expand the experience with richer role-based reporting as the product matures.

projects.title: AD² Restormer
projects.description: A case study for an image restoration pipeline built around the Restormer architecture, with a focus on experimentation, clarity, and practical deployment thinking.
projects.problem: Low-quality or corrupted images need a restoration pipeline that can recover detail without introducing obvious artifacts.
projects.objectives: Document the architecture, training flow, and evaluation story for an AI restoration project in a way that remains readable for both technical and non-technical audiences.
projects.businessNeed: The project highlights how a restoration model can improve the usability of degraded imagery for downstream review, analysis, and decision-making.

features.title: Restoration pipeline
features.description: A practical workflow for loading degraded inputs, running inference, and reviewing outputs with clear visual feedback.

features: Batch evaluation and qualitative review support.

features.title: Model comparison workflow
features.description: A structure for recording benchmarking notes, evaluation tradeoffs, and iteration insights.

challenges.challenge: Balancing model detail with a case-study page that stays readable and easy to update.
challenges.solution: The narrative was organized into focused sections so the experiment story could evolve without losing its structure.

projects.lessonsLearned: The most effective AI case studies explain the technical tradeoffs clearly while keeping the reader focused on the decision and impact.
futureImprovements: Add richer evaluation plots and comparison benchmarks.
Expand the experience with more concrete deployment and model-monitoring details.
